messages.text: Question, is my order classified as a batch or in a warehouse? Trying to find out when the miner would be sent out. Thanks in advance.

Hi Andre,

Good news, neither. The Avalon Q was an in stock unit, not a batch pre order, and it has already shipped.

It left on October 6 by UPS, tracking ····, and it's due with you by October 9. You can follow it here: (tracking link hidden)

Nothing else is outstanding on the order, and your Harlo OS diagnostics line went out the same day.

Once it's up and running, I'm still happy to run the sats and power numbers for Watertown whenever you want them.

If you're pleased with how this went, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com . And you're very welcome in our Discord for setup help and new product news: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Enjoy the Avalon,
Sarah
